import java.util.*;

public class Codeforces
{
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception
    {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        double p = scanner.nextDouble();
        int i;
        for(i=0; i<=n; i++)
            if(probability(n, i) >= p) break;
        System.out.println(i);
        scanner.close();
    }

    static int ncr(int n, int r)
    {
        if(r > n) return 0;
        int ans=1;
        for(int i=n; i>n-r; i--) ans*=i;
        for(int i=2; i<=r; i++) ans/=i;
        return ans;
    }

    static double probability(int n, int x)
    {
        int a = ncr(x, 3) * ncr(n - x, 0);
        int b = ncr(x, 2) * ncr(n - x, 1);
        int c = ncr(x, 1) * ncr(n - x, 2);
        return ((3.0/6)*c + a + b) / ncr(n, 3);
    }
}
